About Digital Products

Digital Products owns the definition, development, and delivery of GM’s digital products and the customer experiences delivered through mobile applications, back-office platforms, and connected services. The organization brings together OnStar & Customer Experience Platforms and Digital Vehicle Experience and works closely with Vehicle Products to deliver digital contributors to the vehicle experience.

Digital Products is an exciting place to begin your career because interns can work on real products, services, tools, and experiences that connect customers with GM. You will learn from experienced professionals, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and gain exposure to how digital products are built, tested, launched, and improved.

About the opportunity

Digital Products is looking for Software Engineer Interns and Software Test Engineer Interns who are excited to build reliable digital products and the systems that support them. Depending on the team, you may contribute to application development, automation, data and integration services, software delivery, test tools, or lab and validation infrastructure.

Assignments are connected to real team priorities and may include design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement across the development lifecycle.

Potential Team & Areas of Work

Opportunities may be aligned to the following groups and product areas from the Digital Products intern intake:

- Consumer Digital Experiences (CDE): Mobile, Vehicle Commerce, Brand Services, and Loyalty

- Emerging and Strategic Businesses (ESB): GM Fleet

- OnStar Sales, Activation and Experience (OnStar SAE): Carrier & Vehicle Experience Services, Commerce, Global Contact Centers & OnStar Safety, and OnStar AI Engineering

- Physical and Virtual Test Platforms: Virtual Test Infrastructure, Virtualization Tools, Vehicle Reflash, Infotainment Lab Operations, HIL simulation integration, and lab operations

- Vehicle Software Integrity and Delivery: Calibration Management Tools, Greylock, Wired Programming, and VCAM

- Digital Vehicle Experience (DVE): Software engineering and software test opportunities supporting digital vehicle experiences

- Build or enhance software features, services, APIs, tools, or automation

- Analyze data, investigate defects, and support troubleshooting or root-cause analysis

- Support software delivery, diagnostics, reflash, validation, lab tooling, or test infrastructure

- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, analysts, technicians, and business partners

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About the Integrated Planning Team

The Integrated Planning & Business Operations team acts as the engine that plans and drives materials for Zipline’s expansion into new metros across the United States. Joining the team means you will be fundamental in the build-out of our planning and analytical frameworks that drive long-term health of our supply chain, ensuring we maintain the rigorous planning, vendor partnerships, and component availability required to meet our deployment demands.

The Role

In the capacity of a Material Planning Intern, you will facilitate the high-level planning and tactical execution necessary for hardware material readiness. This role involves deep collaboration with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Global Supply Management to refine reporting structures, optimize vendor interactions, and drive the successful deployment of major vehicle systems.

We are looking for a highly collaborative, detail-oriented individual who is ready to immerse themselves in the operational foundation that supports Zipline’s global scaling efforts.

This onsite internship will be hosted at our headquarters in South San Francisco.

What You’ll Do

- Support the maintenance of Clear to Build (CTB) tracking for vital systems, assisting with risk mitigation and cross-team communication.

- Develop automated reporting and visibility dashboards focused on part shortages, shipment logistics, and other essential planning data.

- Optimize spares management by evaluating consumption patterns and proposing stocking methodologies for our current flight programs.

- Establish standardized supplier reporting formats for capacity updates and delivery timelines to streamline data intake.

- Iterate on scalable planning workflows and tools that enhance transparency across all functional departments.

What You’ll Bring

- Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s program in Supply Chain, Engineering, or a technical discipline; advanced degrees (MBA/MS) are highly valued.

- Superior analytical capabilities with a proficiency in data tools, ranging from advanced Excel to SQL or Python.

- The ability to translate complex findings into clear insights for diverse internal stakeholders.

- An entrepreneurial mindset characterized by a comfort with ambiguity and a drive to propose and execute solutions independently.

- A genuine passion for our mission and a commitment to making an impact from the first day of your internship.

What Else You Should Know

Our internships are full-time positions, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May/June 2027 to August/September 2027.

Candidates are limited to three (3) applications within a 30-day period.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process.

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About the Long Range Platform Engineering Team

As part of the Long Range Platform Engineering Team, the Embedded Firmware team develops and maintains the software that runs directly on Zipline’s vehicle and ground-system hardware. Our work spans device drivers, sensor and actuator interfaces, power management, communications, fault detection, and safety-critical behavior. Team members collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, systems, test, and operations teams to bring new hardware to life and troubleshoot real-world issues. By making every embedded component reliable, observable, and safe, we help ensure that each delivery vehicle can complete its mission successfully. Our team has the unique opportunity to combine deep hardware knowledge, careful software engineering, and the opportunity to see our code create an immediate physical impact.

Your Role

As an Embedded Firmware intern, you’ll take ownership of a meaningful project that helps improve the safety, reliability, or performance of Zipline’s vehicles and ground systems. You’ll write and test software, work hands-on with hardware, and help investigate real-world behavior seen in our labs and operations. Your work will contribute directly to making autonomous deliveries more dependable for the communities that rely on them! You’ll learn from experienced firmware, electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers through mentorship, design reviews, and collaborative problem-solving. This is an opportunity to build your engineering judgment, get your hands dirty, and make a meaningful contribution to a system with real-world impact.
